title: Opalescence Lighter Grout
description: A simple resourcepack for the mod Opalescence
body:
A simple and small resource pack for my mod Opalescence that lightens the darker areas of some of the blocks.



The resource pack specifically lightens up grout areas in brick-like textures, therefore lessening contrast.



Blocks that have their textures lightened include:
- Chiseled Opal
- Cut Opal
- Opal Bricks
- Opal Glass
- Opal Pillar
- Opal Tiles
- Polished Opal
- Opal Bricks
- Small Opal Bricks


Applies to both the regular and the moonlit opal variants.
